adds: a notification when a carried upstream PR is closed without a merge (once per closure)

a notification when a new official release appears since the last check, with a capability read of its npm package (read in memory, never installed), checked by structure: a GPT-6.1 Sol model object ({id:"gpt-6.1-sol",name:...}) in a server-bundle file, and the /api/v1/alpha/search/route entry of the server's app-paths manifest together with the route file it names; strings elsewhere count for nothing. The result is a notice, not a switch gate: a switch still has to pass switch_gateway.py's probe gate (live catalog, effort-max calls, codex exec).
bounded reads: 400 MiB per compressed package, 64 MiB per decompressed file (a larger file is skipped and listed), 1 GiB of decompressed reads per package

delivery-based state: a notification counts only when osascript exits 0; the notified closure, the notified release and the advanced release tag are written only after delivery, so a failed delivery or a failed package read leaves the item pending for the next run; a failed PR lookup keeps the PR's previous record; a successful capability result is kept on later runs
a dry mode for tests (OMNIROUTE_UPDATE_CHECK_DRY=1) that logs the restart and the notifications instead of performing them
